SoloKeys is the original open hardware FIDO2 project. The Solo 2 line, currently sold from solokeys.com, is licensed under the CERN Open Hardware Licence Strongly Reciprocal and runs the open source Trussed firmware framework. Active maintenance is shared with [Nitrokey](../nitrokey/), which built the Nitrokey 3 on the same firmware base.

SoloKeys' relevance is partly that the hardware is genuinely open, with schematics and firmware on GitHub, and partly that the Solo 2+ NFC is one of a small number of inexpensive NFC capable open hardware keys. Buying a Solo means trusting an open source project rather than a commercial vendor's secure element story, which is a different tradeoff than buying a Yubico or Feitian.
